_comment: Per-job agy settings, passed with `agy --settings <file>`; never written to the global settings.json. `~` is expanded and `{GIT_COMMON_DIR}` is filled in by agy_job.py. Keep `allow` minimal: on consumer accounts an allow rule also lets that command run OUTSIDE the terminal sandbox. Unlisted commands run inside the sandbox (no network, .git read-only), and `ask` is auto-denied in headless mode.
